object_registration.scope: Base and extended initialization, manager-backed construction and registration retain live stack inputs and callback-driven global changes. Allocation composes the recovered manager facade.

object_startup.scope: Prepare, poll/retry and complete object startup, plus lazy construction directly composing the recovered construction and registration APIs. The 15 cases include the earlier 11 startup cases.

array_release_family.scope: One parameter table shares ReleaseArrayElements across element sizes and resize arguments. Original entry bodies are compared for parameters, nested stack position, full r3, ordered service calls, callback-driven pointer changes and persistent memory.
array_release_family.limits: RemoveArrayRange and InitializeManager are controlled oracle boundaries; ReleaseManagerBuffer reuses its recovered implementation. Complete lower behavior and generic ABI state are not revalidated.

memory_runtime_adapter.scope: Full original-PPC context and seeded ordinary-memory comparisons through actual strong wrappers: direct and mapping-table calls with disabled and enabled gates, checking original fallback call counts.
memory_runtime_adapter.implementation: The three recovered memory families share unchanged ApplyWith algorithms with the exact-width volatile native backend, including the live r1 scratch slot and r18 input.

build.runtime: Incremental compile/link passed for the 156 memory wrappers, reusing the existing PPC archive.
build.semantic_library: A subsequent incremental compile/link passed for all eight object APIs and 31 array-release entries. They have no runtime wrappers and are outside this scene's scope.
build.reused_evidence: Existing semantic suites and earlier baseline scenes were reused. No source/image hashes or full PPC regeneration were performed.
